answer: select round(100.0*sum(exists(select 1 from foreign_data f where f.uuid=c.uuid and f.language='French'))/count(*),2) from cards c where c.isStorySpotlight=1
select uuid from cards where duelDeck='a'
select round(100.0*sum(c.cardKingdomId is not null and c.cardKingdomFoilId is not null)/count(*),2) from cards c join sets s on s.code=c.setCode where s.name='Coldsnap'
select count(distinct p.name) from cards p where p.isPromo=1 and p.types like '%Creature%' and exists(select 1 from cards b where b.name=p.name and b.leadershipSkills like '%''brawl'': True%')
select max(cast(frameVersion as integer))-min(cast(frameVersion as integer)) from cards where name='Tarmogoyf' and frameVersion<>'future'
select frameVersion, count(*) from cards where frameVersion='future' group by frameVersion

select s.name, round(100.0*sum(case when c.manaCost is not null and c.manaCost<>'' and c.convertedManaCost<=3 then 1 else 0 end)/count(*),2) 
from sets s join cards c on c.setCode=s.code
where s.code in (
 (select s2.code from sets s2 where exists(select 1 from cards x where x.setCode=s2.code and x.name='Abyssal Horror') order by s2.releaseDate, s2.code limit 1),
 (select code from sets order by releaseDate desc, code limit 1))
group by s.code order by s.releaseDate

select name from cards where setCode='DKA' and (','||keywords||',') like '%,Flash,%' and convertedManaCost=(select max(convertedManaCost) from cards where setCode='DKA' and (','||keywords||',') like '%,Flash,%') order by name

select s.name,s.keyruneCode,count(distinct t.language) from sets s left join set_translations t on t.setCode=s.code and t.translation is not null where s.releaseDate between '2020-01-01' and '2020-12-31' group by s.code
select count(*) from cards where setCode in ('AER','AKH','C17','MP2','OC17','PAER','PAKH')

select s.type,count(distinct case when t.language='Japanese' and t.translation is not null then s.code end) from sets s left join set_translations t on t.setCode=s.code group by s.type order by s.type

select count(*) from cards where setCode in (select setCode from cards where name='Ancestor''s Chosen' order by (select releaseDate from sets where code=setCode) desc limit 1) and types like '%Creature%' and cast(power as int)>cast(toughness as int)
select distinct name from cards where isPromo=1 and layout in ('split','transform','adventure','modal_dfc','flip','meld','aftermath') and originalReleaseDate like '2019/%'
select sum(convertedManaCost) from cards where artist='Rob Alexander' and originalReleaseDate like '2013/%'
